title: How to add Zoom to Google Calendar (and make it the default option)
summary: Google Meet is the default for every Google Calendar event you create. If Meet isn't your thing, though, here's how to add Zoom to Google Calendar.
body_markdown:
Google Meet is baked into just about everything Google makes—including Google Calendar, where it's the default video conferencing option on every event you create.


If Meet isn't your thing, though, you're not stuck with it. Here's how to add Zoom to Google Calendar (and make it the default meeting option).


**Table of contents** :


-


How to add Zoom to Google Calendar


-


How to make Zoom the default in Google Calendar


-


Automate Google Calendar and Zoom with Zapier


## How to add Zoom to Google Calendar


To get started, you'll need to install the Zoom Google Calendar plugin. Here's how.


1.


Go to[calendar.google.com](http://calendar.google.com/) , and log in.


2.


Click the **Get Add-ons** icon (` +` ) in the right side panel.


3.


In the Google Workspace Marketplace popup that appears, search "Zoom for Google Workspace."


4.


Click **Install** in the Zoom for Google Workspace card.


5.


Click **Continue** , and follow the prompts to install. (If you're a Google Workplace admin, you can install Zoom for your entire domain.)


6.


Click **Done** , and then close out of the Google Workspace Marketplace popover.


7.


Now,[schedule a Google Calendar meeting](https://zapier.com/blog/google-calendar-schedule/) as you normally would. While you're creating the event, click **Add Google Meet video conferencing** , and select **Zoom Meeting** .


The first time you add a Zoom meeting, you'll be prompted to log in to your Zoom account. But once you do, you'll be all set moving forward.


The Zoom meeting details, including the meeting link, phone number, and meeting agenda, will automatically populate in the calendar event.


## How to make Zoom the default in Google Calendar


Making Zoom the default video conferencing app in Google Calendar requires a Google Workspace admin account (there's no way to do this for personal Gmail accounts).


First, you need to remove Google Meet as the default for Google Calendar events.


1.


Go to[admin.google.com](https://admin.google.com/) .


2.


Click the menu (` ≡` ), and select **Apps** > **Google Workspace** > **Google Meet** .


3.


Click the dropdown, and select **OFF for everyone** .


4.


Click **Save.**


Now you can make Zoom the default meeting space.


1.


Go to[admin.google.com](https://admin.google.com/) .


2.


Click the menu (` ≡` ), and select **Apps** > **Google Workspace** > **Calendar** .


3.


Click **Sharing Settings** , and then select **Video Conferencing** .


4.


Check the box next to *Automatically add video calls to events users create* .


5.


Click **Save** .


The video conferencing button in Google Calendar will change to *Add video conferencing* . When you click it, it'll automatically populate Zoom meeting details (again, assuming Zoom is the only video conferencing app installed).


It would be nice if this were possible without disabling Meet entirely, but this method works, so give it a shot if you're tired of switching from one service to another depending on who makes the appointment.
